description: This PHP file provides utility functions for the TestLink Open Source Project, including displaying a sample database message and running a test by executing XML-RPC client methods with debug outputs.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a message about the sample database setup for TestLink API.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes a specified method on the XML-RPC client with given arguments, provides debugging output, and returns the server response.
